diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 024daa5..3b26cce 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,66 @@
+pmdk (1.13.1-1.2ubuntu1) tenacious; urgency=medium
+
+  * Merge with Debian unstable (LP: #2174447). Remaining changes:
+    - Fix FTBFS issues in ppc64el:
+      + d/rules: skip ppc64el build time tests
+  * Dropped changes:
+    - d/rules: disable the GCS warning on arm64 due to GCC15
+      (LP 2119445)
+      [Not needed anymore for Ubuntu Tenacious]
+    - d/p/cmake-min-version-bump.patch: Bump Cmake minimum version to 3.5 to
+      fix FTBFS surfaced with Cmake 4.2.3 (LP 2148814).
+      [Fixed in Debian 1.13.1-1.2]
+
+ -- Hector Cao <hector.cao@canonical.com>  Wed, 18 Nov 2026 13:16:42 +0100
+
+pmdk (1.13.1-1.2) unstable; urgency=medium
+
+  * Non-maintainer upload.
+  * Build with CMake 4. (Closes: #1113414)
+  * Build on loong64. (Closes: #1074301)
+
+ -- Bastian Germann <bage@debian.org>  Mon, 05 Jan 2026 13:20:31 +0100
+
+pmdk (1.13.1-1.1ubuntu5) stonking; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/p/cmake-min-version-bump.patch: Bump Cmake minimum version to 3.5 to
+    fix FTBFS surfaced with Cmake 4.2.3 (LP: #2148814).
+
+ -- Nathan Pratta Teodosio <nteodosio@ubuntu.com>  Wed, 27 May 2026 16:08:41 +0000
+
+pmdk (1.13.1-1.1ubuntu4) resolute; urgency=medium
+
+  * No-change mass rebuild for Ubuntu 26.04 (LP: #2132257)
+
+ -- Sebastien Bacher <seb128@debian.org>  Mon, 02 Feb 2026 21:35:50 +0100
+
+pmdk (1.13.1-1.1ubuntu3) questing; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/rules: disable the GCS warning on arm64 (LP: #2119445)
+
+ -- Andreas Hasenack <andreas@canonical.com>  Wed, 24 Sep 2025 17:06:49 -0300
+
+pmdk (1.13.1-1.1ubuntu2) noble; urgency=medium
+
+  * Fix FTBFS issues in ppc64el:
+    - d/rules: skip ppc64el build time tests
+    - d/p/debian-changes: remove bogus file
+
+ -- Athos Ribeiro <athos.ribeiro@canonical.com>  Thu, 18 Apr 2024 09:44:59 -0300
+
+pmdk (1.13.1-1.1ubuntu1) noble; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/rules: Disable TEST5 on ppc64el to fix FTBFS
+    (LP: #2061913)
+
+ -- Bryce Harrington <bryce@canonical.com>  Tue, 16 Apr 2024 16:17:03 -0700
+
+pmdk (1.13.1-1.1build1) noble; urgency=high
+
+  * No change rebuild for 64-bit time_t and frame pointers.
+
+ -- Julian Andres Klode <juliank@ubuntu.com>  Mon, 08 Apr 2024 18:15:44 +0200
+

diff --git a/debian/patches/loong.patch b/debian/patches/loong.patch

@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+Origin: https://github.com/daos-stack/pmdk/pull/29
+From: liuxiang <liuxiang@loongson.cn>
+Date: Fri, 5 Jan 2024 15:25:33 +0800
+Subject: common: fix compilation error on LoongArch
+
+Signed-off-by: liuxiang <liuxiang@loongson.cn>

+--- a/src/libpmem2/loongarch64/init.c
++++ b/src/libpmem2/loongarch64/init.c

+ {
+ 	LOG(3, NULL);
+ 
+-	info->fence = loongarch_fence;
++	info->fence = loongarch_memory_fence;
+ 	info->flush = loongarch_flush;
+ }
